study type: Genetic Case Study with Functional Assays
cohort: Three related males with normal head circumferences, mild learning difficulties, hypopituitarism (GH and TSH deficiencies), and an unusual form of glucose dysregulation were studied.
finding: A novel hemizygous EIF2S3 variant, p.Pro432Ser, was identified in three related males, leading to impaired eIF2g function and a relatively mild phenotype characterized by mild learning difficulties, hypopituitarism, and glucose dysregulation, thereby expanding the range of phenotypes associated with EIF2S3 mutations.
